author: neal_illustrator
title: Looking for artists to build comic and animation teams
content: Heyo! I’m doing an all call looking for artists to help build out my comic and animation teams! I think it’s time to try and ease up some of the stress and expand my team! I’m excited to see y’all’s portfolios! I’m so excited to have the team grow! I’m like a little studio now! Stay stellar!! Application Links are in my linktree (in bio)

author: harrier_studio
title: Harrier Studio is hiring illustrators and comic artists
content: HARRIER STUDIO IS HIRING! OPEN POSITIONS: Illustrator (Full Stage), Sketch Artist (Drafter), Line Artist, Colorist, Compositor, Storyboard Artist, Styling Artist, Typesetter. Send CV & Portfolio to: harrierstdrecruitment@gmail.com (Subject: Nama – Posisi – CV & Portofolio). Open until all positions filled.

author: truchargv
title: Looking for illustrators to join illustrator pool
content: We're looking for some incredible artists to join our Illustrator pool! Tap the link in bio to apply! Our illustrator pool is used for articles, newsletters, social media posts etc. Illustrators will be chosen and reached out to as needed.

author: willai3213
title: Seeking designer for exhibition visuals including character art
content: 【徵｜展覽平面設計專案合作 】近期正在籌備一場預計於 12月初在台北華山 舉辦的展覽，想尋找一位有興趣合作的平面設計師。預計設計內容含主視覺、標準字、角色視覺設計（共 6 款）、角色立牌等。希望尋找有展覽／平面設計經驗，風格偏手繪、日式、溫暖風格的設計師合作。有興趣的設計師歡迎留言或私訊，請附上作品集＋報價。
